Text.Page:
[EN] I helped build this village...so many happy memories, torn down and left to burn...

But as long as the children are safe, as long as Tiaran still stands, everything will be alright.
[ES] Ayudé a construir esta aldea... Tantos recuerdos felices, destrozados y dejados ardiendo...

Pero mientras los niños estén a salvo, mientras Tiaran siga en pie, todo estará bien.
